about: Characters and relationships for the relationship web. Every speaker in Story/*/flow_graph.json must match a character here (by 'speaker', or by 'name' if there's no 'speaker'), except the ones in ignore_speakers. 'route' limits the match to one story, for people with the same speaker name in different stories (Mom). In a link, 'to_is' is what 'to' is to 'from', and 'from_is' is what 'from' is to 'to'.

characters.name: Kay
characters.about: Grade 11. Group leader by default. Carries everything and says "it's fine."

characters.name: Elysia
characters.about: Cheerful, the friend everyone calls. Was "bug girl" once, and decided never to be weird again.

characters.name: Ulyn
characters.about: Student council. Always busy. Sleeps on his cousin's couch so he doesn't have to go home.

characters.name: Mint
characters.about: Blunt. In a different class. Has known Elysia since kindergarten.

characters.name: Bank
characters.about: Group 3. Not a bad person, just used to Kay doing it.

characters.name: Fern
characters.about: Group 3. Good at slides, better at photos.

characters.name: Ms. Noi
characters.about: Home economics teacher. Garden project advisor. Runs the guidance room on Thursdays.

characters.name: Ploy
characters.about: Loud, generous, dramatic. Leads Elysia's friend group and leans on Elysia the hardest.

characters.name: Jane
characters.about: Part of Elysia's friend group. Follows Ploy's lead.

characters.name: Bow
characters.about: Part of Elysia's friend group. Usually on her phone.

characters.name: Nam
characters.about: A quiet girl in Elysia's class who draws in the margins of everything.

characters.name: Pun
characters.about: Eight years old. Loves bugs the way Elysia used to.

characters.name: Tan
characters.about: 21, a university student. Lets Ulyn sleep on his couch, and keeps asking when he's going home.

characters.name: Pim
characters.about: Student council president. Organized to the point of being frightening.

characters.name: Kay's Mom
characters.speaker: Mom
characters.about: Hospital shifts, always tired. Raised Kay alone.

characters.name: Elysia's Mom
characters.speaker: Mom
characters.about: Thinks Elysia is her easy one.

characters.name: Ulyn's Mom
characters.speaker: Mom
characters.about: Works at a bank. Alone in a house that's too quiet since the separation.
